sections.heading: Who provides the service
sections.body: getproperty is provided by Collective Group (Thailand) to building rental businesses and building managers ("customers").

sections.heading: Using the service
sections.body: Customers are responsible for the units, leases and rates they record. The service refuses to issue an invoice that breaks the law and shows the legal reference.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.body: Fees follow the chosen plan and the number of units in use. While a subscription is unpaid the account is read-only; data can still be viewed and exported.

sections.heading: Ending the service
sections.body: Customers may cancel at any time and export their data before the account closes.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Account data (name, phone, email) and the data customers record to run their buildings, such as residents, leases, meter readings and payments.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: To provide the contracted service, issue invoices and receipts, verify identity, keep the service secure and comply with the law.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: Only as needed with processors acting for us, such as SMS providers, banks and cloud providers, under contracts that protect the data.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask to access, correct, delete, object to or receive a copy of your data under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019). Contact us on LINE or by the email in your account.

sections.heading: Controller and processor
sections.body: For residents' data the building owner (the customer) is the controller and getproperty processes it on the customer's instructions. For user-account data getproperty is the controller.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Performance of a contract, legal obligations, and the legitimate interest of keeping the service secure. Consent is used only where the law requires it.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Kept only as long as the purpose and accounting and tax laws require, then deleted or de-identified.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: getproperty processes the personal data of residents and parties only to provide the service as the customer instructs.

sections.heading: Security measures
sections.body: Encryption in transit and of sensitive stored data, row-level isolation of each customer's data, and an audit trail of every access.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
sections.body: Only the sub-processors the service needs; customers are told in advance of a change.

sections.heading: Breach notification
sections.body: Customers are told without undue delay of a personal data breach, so they can notify the PDPC within the legal deadline.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.more: Can't find your answer? Message us on LINE

meters.q: Do I have to replace every meter?
meters.a: No. Start with your existing meters by photo or by hand. If you want meters that report themselves, we assess and install smart meters floor by floor.

money.q: Is it really free? How does getproperty make money?
money.a: Yes — no monthly fee and nothing per unit. We earn a fee per payment the platform confirms. Money goes through a licensed payment provider and is settled to your building's account; getproperty never holds your funds.

residents.q: What do residents need to do?
residents.a: Add your building's LINE account and link their unit once. After that, bills, QR codes and receipts arrive in LINE every month.

import.q: Can I move my data from Excel or my current software?
import.a: Yes. Units, residents and rates can be imported from a file, and our team will look over the file with you before you start.

data.q: How safe is my residents' data?
data.a: Sensitive data is encrypted, backups run daily, and we sign a PDPA data processing agreement with every building owner.
